name: google/nano-banana-2-lite/edit

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The seed for the random number generator.

images.title: Image URLs
images.description: The URLs of the images to use for image-to-image generation or image editing.

prompt.title: Prompt
examples: make a photo of the man driving the car down the california coastline

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: The aspect ratio of the generated image. Leave empty to keep the aspect ratio of the input image.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: The format of the generated image.

system_prompt.title: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: Optional system instruction that steers the model's persona and output style across the request. Leave blank to omit; when provided, it is sent as the system instruction to Gemini (or as a system message on OpenAI-compatible providers).

thinking_level.title: Thinking Level
thinking_level.description: When set, enables model thinking with the given level ('minimal' or 'high') and includes thoughts in the generation. Omit to disable.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generation task.

error.description: Error message if the task failed. Empty on success.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

status.description: Status of the task: pending, running, completed, failed, or timeout.

url.description: The URL where the generated content can be downloaded from.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the output file.

outputs.description: Array of generated content. Empty when status is not completed.

readme:
# Nano Banana 2 Lite Edit

Nano Banana 2 Lite Edit: fast, low-cost edits and multi-image composition at 1K with Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Up to 50,000 characters. |
| `images` | image URL[], required | — | Images to edit or combine, Image 1, Image 2, … |
| `output_format` | `jpeg` / `png` | `png` | Output file format. |
| `system_prompt` | string | — | Optional standing instructions applied to every request. |
| `thinking_level` | `minimal` / `high` | — | `high` reasons more about the prompt before drawing; `minimal` is faster. |
| `aspect_ratio` | `21:9` / `16:9` / `3:2` / `4:3` / `5:4` / `1:1` / `4:5` / `3:4` / `2:3` / `9:16` | — | Omit to follow the first input image. |
| `seed` | integer | random | Fix it to compare prompt changes. |

## Billing

$0.0336 per 1K image, Google's list price.

| Request | Price |
|---|---|
| One image | $0.0336 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Keep prompts direct; use `thinking_level: high` for complex layouts.

## Limits

- Output is 1K only.

## Also on SandBase

Other Nano Banana endpoints: `google/nano-banana-pro`, `google/nano-banana-pro/edit`, `google/nano-banana-2`, `google/nano-banana-2/edit`, `google/nano-banana-2-lite`.
